IGUI_StoryEngine_PingText: This is a test transmission. Respond if you can hear me.
IGUI_StoryEngine_JournalEmpty: Nothing written yet. An entry is written when you go to sleep.
IGUI_StoryEngine_FallbackDiary: %1. Spent the day around %2. Killed %3 zombies. %4 things worth noting happened.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Notice_Supply: [Radio] Someone left supplies in a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of here. (Marked in Quests and on the map)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_Empty: No quests yet. Supply drops you hear about will show up here.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_Storage: Stored in: %1 (the marked spot on the map)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_Storage_Floor: Stored on: the floor (the marked spot on the map)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_Storage_Unknown: Stored in: somewhere inside. You will know the exact spot when you get close.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Radio_NoRadio: You need a two-way radio (walkie-talkie or ham radio) to talk.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Radio_Empty: It is quiet on %1's frequency. Say something first.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Radio_Error_cooldown: Wait a moment before talking again
IGUI_StoryEngine_Radio_Error_rate_limite: You have been on the radio too much
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_From_supply_drop: %1 told you over the radio that supplies were left for you. (%2 %3)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_From_fetch: %1 asked you over the radio to retrieve something. (%2 %3)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_Goal_supply_drop: Take everything from the storage in the building to complete it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_Goal_fetch: Find the item, keep it on you, and press 'Hand over by radio'. You get a supply reward.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_Result_failed: Failed: not done before the deadline. The items are gone.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_Submit_ok: Handed over. The reward was added to your quests.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_Submit_no_item: You are not carrying the quest item
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_supply_drop: Left some supplies for you near %1. It's a building about %3 tiles %2 of you. Grab them before someone else does.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_fetch: Got a job for you. There's a %4 in a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you. Bring it and call me on the radio. I'll make it worth your while.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_reward: Got it, thanks. Your payment is in a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Radio_FollowUp: Will call back in about %1 h
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_From_deliver: %1 asked you for help over the radio. (%2 %3)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_Goal_proposed: Accept or decline. If you accept, bring the items before the deadline. Helping raises trust by the request's tier; declining, ignoring or breaking the promise lowers it (less for harder requests).
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_Goal_deliver: Carry all the items and press 'Hand over by radio'. You get a supply reward.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_Result_failed_del: Failed: the items were not delivered in time.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_Submit_missing_it: You do not have all the items
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_request: Could you spare %1? I'll pay you back, I promise. Answer me on the radio.
IGUI_StoryEngine_TrustReason_gift_comple: you picked up what they left
IGUI_StoryEngine_TrustReason_gift_failed: you left their supplies to rot
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_From_trade: A trade you asked %1 for over the radio. (%2 %3)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Trade_Goal_proposed: Accept or decline the offer. If you accept, pay with the items they want before the deadline, and the goods will be left in a nearby building.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Trade_Goal_pay: Press 'Choose payment' and pick items of the requested kind worth at least the price.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Trade_Result_completed: Trade done. The goods were left in a nearby building.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Trade_Result_failed: Failed: you did not pay before the deadline.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Trade_Paid: Payment sent. The goods were added to your quests.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_From_horde: %1 asked you over the radio to clear out a horde. (%2 %3)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Horde_Goal_proposed: Accept or decline. If you accept, the dead will be gathered around the building. Kill most of them before the deadline. Succeeding raises trust by the request's tier.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Horde_Goal: Kill the dead around the marked building. The reward is left nearby once most of them are down.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Horde_Result_completed: The horde is cleared. The reward was left nearby.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Horde_Result_failed: Failed: the horde was not cleared before the deadline.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Horde_Bar: %1 asks you to clear a horde of about %3 near %2
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_horde: There's a pack of about %4 dead gathered around a building near %1, %3 tiles %2 of you. Can you clear them out? I'll leave you something for it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_From_reward_fetch: %1's payment for finding what they asked for. (%2 %3)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_From_reward_deliv: %1's payment for the supplies you brought them. (%2 %3)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_From_reward_horde: %1's payment for clearing out the horde. (%2 %3)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_Storage_Highlight: The container glows orange when you get close.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_reward_trade: Got your payment. The goods are in a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_reward_horde: Good work out there. Your reward is in a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_bitten_1: No. No no no. It got me.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_bitten_2: That's a bite. I know what that means.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_bitten_3: Just a bite... just a bite. Keep breathing.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_low_health_1: I can't take much more of this.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_low_health_3: I need to patch myself up. Now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_first_kill_1: It was a person once. It was a person.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_first_kill_2: I did it. My hands won't stop shaking.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_first_kill_3: So that's how it is now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_kills_1: That's %1 of them. It doesn't get easier.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_kills_2: %1 now. I stopped seeing faces somewhere back there.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_wounded_1: Ow. Need to clean that before it gets bad.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_wounded_3: Just a scratch. It's only a scratch.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_wake_2: For a second I forgot. Then I didn't.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_wake_3: Up. Water, food, then we'll see.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_new_town_1: %1. Never thought I'd see it like this.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_supply_found_1: They actually left it. Somebody kept their word.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_supply_found_2: That'll keep me going a while.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_supply_found_3: Good. Now get out before company shows up.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_horde_cleared_1: That's the last of them. I think.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_horde_cleared_3: They'd better have been worth it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_storm_1: Sky's turning black. Better find a roof.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_storm_2: Storm's coming. At least the noise covers mine.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_storm_3: Thunder. The dead won't mind, but I do.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_pain_3: I'd trade anything for a painkiller.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_sick_2: I feel awful. Please be something I ate.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_stress_3: I need a minute. Just one.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_bored_2: I'd kill for a book. Or a radio show.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_hungry_2: When did I last eat properly?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_tired_1: Can barely keep my eyes open.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_tired_3: I need to sleep somewhere safe.
IGUI_StoryEngine_DebugDenied: StoryEngine debug commands need admin rights on this server (/setaccesslevel <name> admin)
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_horde_warning: Heads up! About %1 of the dead are heading your way from the %2. Get ready.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_rescue: I picked up a distress call. Someone's trapped in a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you. I can't get there. Can you check on them?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_From_rescue: %1 relayed a distress call: someone said they were trapped in this building. (%2 %3)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_Goal_rescue: Go to the building and find out what happened to the survivor. Take everything from the marked container to finish. Watch out inside.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_Fight: Fighting near the spot: %1 killed, %2 injuries
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_Fight_bitten: Fighting near the spot: %1 killed, %2 injuries, someone was bitten
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_helicopter_2: That noise will bring every one of them.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mono_helicopter_3: They're not landing. They're not coming for us.

IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_Result_failed_ext: The deadline passed. They made good on the threat.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_extort: Hand over %1. You've got %2 hours. Or the dead come knocking.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quest_From_friend: %1 set these aside for you without being asked. (%2 %3)
